गम् गम्, i. 1, गच्छ, Par. (in poetry also Ātm., Rām. 5, 1, 41).
 1. To go, Man. 4, 47.
 2. To move, Hit. i. d. 84; Rām. 3, 52, 12.
 3. To go to (with acc.), MBh. 1, 5746; वनेन वनं गत्वा, Going from one forest to another, Rām. 1, 1, 30; अवनीं जानुभ्याम्, To fall upon one's knees, MBh. 13, 935; धरनीं मूर्ध्ना, To bow one's head to the ground, Rām. 3, 11, 6; एनो गच्छति कर्तारम्, An evil deed recoils on him who committed it, Man. 8, 19; with the loc., Pañc. 129, 4; with the dat., MBh. 3, 453; with प्रति, Nal. 26, 1.

 6. To know carnally (with the acc.), Man. 8, 376 (Ātm.); Yājñ. 2, 289.
